test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Shalini exclaimed that the painting was enchanting.

options.text: Shalini exclaimed, “Ahha! Look at the paintings!”
Shalini said, “Such an enchanting painting this is!”

solution:
The correct answer is ***'Shalini said, “Such an enchanting painting this is!”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​​We need to convert the sentence from Indirect speech to direct speech.
 
• The past tense of the main verb is changed to the present tense.
 
• Punctuations including commas and inverted commas are introduced.
 
• The connecter '**that**' is eliminat
